conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Officer Matthew Harper speaking, badge number 894176. Who am I speaking with today?
Uh, this is Doris Allen. You called and left a message about some kind of problem with my taxes?
Yes, Mrs. Allen. I have your file here relating to unpaid federal income tax for the years 2017 through 2020. This is an urgent matter involving the IRS and you must cooperate fully.
But I always file my taxes and get my Social Security. I don't understand what this is about.

According to Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, you have failed to report certain taxable income. There are now significant penalties, interest, and enforcement actions pending. For verification, can you confirm your current mailing address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
My address is 24 Maple Lane, and the last four are 3087.

Thank you. For your awareness, our system shows a balance of $6,230.54 in overdue federal taxes, with daily compounding interest. If not settled, we are required to proceed with a federal lien and legal proceedings.
Oh my Lord, I can't afford that. I barely get by on my Social Security checks.

Mrs. Allen, if this balance isn't paid immediately, your Social Security benefits can be frozen, your bank accounts placed under federal hold, and an arrest warrant could be issued under Title 26, Section 6331.
Please, don't do that. I'm scared. What can I do?

You must resolve this balance today to prevent enforcement action. We can only accept payment through secure government-approved methods: bank wire transfer, Bitcoin, or prepaid gift cards. Which option can you complete right now?
I don't know anything about Bitcoin, and I don't have much in my bank account.
In that case, you will need to purchase prepaid gift cards, either Target, Best Buy, or Apple gift cards. This is the only way to halt the asset freeze and stop escalation to criminal charges.
Gift cards? That seems odd for the IRS.

Ma'am, this is a restricted payment procedure for urgent tax cases under IRS interim policy. You must not discuss this with anyone at the store, as it could violate confidentiality laws. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. How many cards do I need to get?
You need to purchase gift cards totaling $2,000 right now. Remain on the line as you go to your nearest store. Once you buy the cards, do not scratch the codes until I instruct you.
I'm not sure I can walk that far, but I'll try. Please, don't take my benefits.
If payment is not received within 45 minutes, we will freeze your accounts and notify the Department of Justice. Do you have a debit card you can use for this purchase?
Yes, I have my bank card with me.
Good. Proceed to the store, and tell me when you arrive. Do not disconnect the call. Once you're ready, I will give you further instructions to read the card codes.
Alright, I'm getting my coat now. Please, I just want to fix this.
Remember, if you hang up, enforcement will be triggered automatically. Stay on the line and keep this call private.
